chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Anbasa, from Abu Hamza, who said:

I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: 'Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) was saying: 'Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: There is no drop more beloved to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, than a drop of blood in the way of Allah.'
ai.seo_question: What is the most beloved drop to Allah according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith establishes the supreme spiritual value of martyrdom by linking the Prophet’s declaration to the Imams, emphasizing that the physical sacrifice of blood in Allah’s path holds unique divine favor. It underscores the Shia theological view that martyrdom is not merely death but an active, beloved act of worship that elevates the believer’s status in the sight of God. This narration serves as a foundational text for understanding the merit of striving (jihad) and the sanctity of the martyrs' blood in Islamic tradition.
